name: paperloo-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Paperloo SaaS governance, automated legal disclosures, and compliance auditing.

tools.name: verify_compliance
tools.description: Audit a web domain or URL for essential statutory compliance indicators (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, cookie banner, privacy disclosures, WCAG accessibility signals)

domain.description: Domain name or URL to scan (e.g. acme.com or https://acme.com)

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: Retrieve list of supported global compliance jurisdictions, statutory regulations, and enforcement authorities

tools.name: get_policy_templates
tools.description: List available automated legal document templates (privacy_policy, terms_of_service, cookie_policy, eula, acceptable_use) and required input schema

tools.name: get_system_status
tools.description: Check real-time health, uptime, and regulatory monitoring synchronization status of Paperloo infrastructure
